summary: Held the full window. Entry dipped hard to -25.5pts (giveback 116%) in the first 2-4min but always bounced -- the drop never showed sustained trend-continuation lambda alongside price staying below zero for more than a frame or two, so I treated it as noise on a good trade rather than a wrong-direction signal. By t=6-8m price broke to +26/+37 and spent the rest of the 45min window oscillating in a wide but consistently positive band (roughly 0 to +37), repeatedly pulling back toward flat/slightly negative for a frame then recovering -- classic chop-around-a-working-thesis, not a one-way breakdown. Never bailed because there was no point where price broke down AND stayed down with confirming against-fires across multiple timeframes simultaneously; the few times all three fire families (KMDR/HA/PROPP) went against at once (t=23m), price was only -1.25pts and recovered within 2 frames. Next time I'd watch for: negative giveback sustained >3 consecutive frames combined with lambda_t significantly positive on 5m/15m while z_se is deeply negative (true trend-continuation away from mean, not chop) as the real bail trigger, rather than reacting to single-frame excursions.
